nom: ANUA 3 Ceramide Panthenol Moisture Barrier Cream

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-combination skin generally say it stays lightweight without adding shine or breakouts, though one reviewer with oily skin found it sat heavier and left her skin slightly oilier.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers are the largest and most consistent group, reporting deep, lasting hydration and fewer dry patches, including during winter and in humid climates.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including dry-leaning and oily-leaning combination skin, say it balances both without tipping into greasiness or tightness.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split between several who say it calmed rosacea, eczema, dermatitis or general reactivity without stinging, and a few early reviewers whose sensitive or acne-prone skin reacted with redness and breakouts.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 30s to early 60s with mature, dry skin describe brighter, more hydrated skin, with one crediting it with a large but unmeasured reduction in wrinkle appearance.

concerns.aging: A few reviewers with fine lines or mild wrinkling say those lines look less pronounced with regular use; one reviewer credits it with a dramatic, self-estimated reduction in wrinkle appearance, though this is not corroborated by other reviews and is not a measured claim.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers describing chronic dryness or post-cleansing tightness report deep, long-lasting hydration and visibly fewer dry patches within days to a few weeks, including in cold or humid climates; a couple note the cream takes noticeably longer to fully absorb than a typical lotion.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers who mention redness, rosacea, or reactive skin say it visibly calms flare-ups within days to two weeks, including redness triggered by benzoyl peroxide, rosacea, or dermatitis; one reviewer with dry, acne-prone, sensitive skin reports the opposite, saying it left her face red all day.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers using it to repair a compromised barrier after over-exfoliating, retinoids, acids, or mandelic-acid overuse report calmer, less reactive, more resilient skin within one to several weeks; one reviewer who also bought it for barrier repair says it irritated her skin instead.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and some see fewer breakouts or calmer acne-related redness, including alongside tretinoin, but at least three early reviewers with acne-prone or sensitive skin report new breakouts or deep, cystic-like pimples within one to two weeks of starting it.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin mostly say the cream stays lightweight and doesn't add shine, but one reviewer with oily skin found it sat heavier and made her skin somewhat oilier, and suggests using less product if your skin runs oily.

aspects.libelle: Rich, creamy texture that still sinks in
Sticky or slow to fully absorb at night
Layers well under makeup and sunscreen
Hygienic tube packaging versus a jar
Good value for the size and price

extraits.titre: Not what I expected — caused breakouts
extraits.texte: I have dry and somewhat sensitive skin, and I bought this product hoping for hydration without clogging my pores. From the first application, I noticed the texture was very heavy and greasy, and it didn't absorb well. After a few days of use, I started getting breakouts in areas where I don't usually have acne, especially on my forehead and cheeks. My skin also felt congested and looked overly shiny, even when using a small amount. It might work better for extremely dry skin types, but unfortunately, it didn't work for me. I stopped using it and my skin started to improve. I wouldn't repurchase or recommend it for sensitive or breakout-prone skin.

extraits.titre: they tried aka anua but a no for them
extraits.texte: I honestly do not like this product at all. Im trying to repair my barrier, i saw this product advertised over tiktok so I got it for my dry acne prone sensitive skin. Big mistake, made my skin so red ALL DAY. It didnt relax like at all. My skin likes barrier repair ingredients and centella, I dont know why it irritated my skin. I like the concept of this product, only positive thing i can say. The product went into the trash

extraits.titre: From a sensitive skin girlie: this stuff rocks
extraits.texte: I am not one to leave reviews on skincare. Ever. Mostly because I have insanely fussy skin and most products just don't work for me. I recently defeated a stubborn, years long case of perioral dermatitis and was looking for a gentle moisturizer. Trust me I've tried many if not all of the other "gentle" ones. I truly love this stuff because it doesn't contain the typical fatty alcohols (cetyl/cetearyl/stearyl) that give me juicy pimples or niacinamide, which burns my face quite a bit in any concentration. This really calms my redness and does not aggravate my dermatitis. Which is a small miracle. The first time I tried it I looked at my husband and said "this cream may be amazing because I forgot I had it on". Any sensitive skin friends out there you know what I'm talking about. Any time I've tried a new product I'm always feeling something: a burn, a tingle, an itch. This just felt…calm. Anua please don't alter the formulation or get rid of this because I will cry real tears. I am so happy to have a moisturizer that I can continue to purchase and not worry if it will hurt me or not!

I decided to buy it because my skin was freaking out by using too many acids on my skin. My skin was breaking out and everything i put on it burned. I have oily skin and usually only use gel moisturizers. But i looked at the ingredients and saw some reviews that it was lightweight so i took a chance with this moisturizer. Im so glad i did!! I only use it at night because i use gel moisturizers in the morning, and i wake up to healthy glowy skin. So even if you have oily skin, i still recommend it but it is indeed lightweight!

extraits.titre: Finally a great, calming, deeply moisturising product
extraits.texte: I have acne-prone sensitive dry-leaning combination skin, and this moisturiser feels extremely deeply moisturising! It feels like it immediately quenches my dry skin without irritating it. The texture is creamy and thick-ish which is exactly what I was looking for. I was tired of all the "lightweight" moisturisers that were never quite sufficient for my dry skin, especially during colder months. This product was the perfect solution.

extraits.titre: Perfect for dry, acne-prone, reactive skin!
extraits.texte: This past winter, my skin decided it wanted to freak out. My acne hasnt been this terrible since my teens - deep, painful hormonal breakouts on my cheeks and chin. I developed psoriasis along my hairline and ears that was painful to the touch. I tried a lot of products over the past 7 months and while my skin isn't perfect again, I finally have a regimen down that has seems to keep my skin calm and happy. My main concern was delivering moisture to my skin to keep the psoriasis at bay, without causing more breakouts in the process, and without being too heavy for the humid Chicago summers. This moisturizer is incredible! It's very rich, but not too heavy for daytime wear. It does take a while to fully dry down, but it doesnt pill with other products and makeup looks dewy and smooth over top. It doesn't feel like it's suffocating my skin. I am a very sweaty person and I never feel like I have the dreaded sweat mustache that a heavy moisturizer will usually give me. For nighttime, it's a dream. I usually slather on a thick layer to seal in the rest of my skincare, and again my skin feels soothed and not smothered. I wake up with glowy and bouncy skin and any redness I had before bed is significantly calmed down. I love it and I will repurchase again and again! A little goes a long way. I've had my first tube for over a month and I'm barely half way through.

I have been a Licensed Esthetician for over four years and loved hearing about this new product. I am in my early 60s and I am always looking for products and cosmetics to improve my personal appearance as well as my skin health. I take pride in skin as it is my clients first impression before their facial. "This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review" Anua 3+Ceramide 3 + Panthenol moisture Barrier Cream is nothing short of amazing on my mature, dry skin. I love how it feels on my skin and I love how my skin looks so much brighter in the am and hydrated. I use about a dime size amount to massage in after cleansing and serum, it massages in well, it is creamy and luxurious, no fragrance and no stickiness afterward. I also use it on rainy days under my foundation and it does not roll off which is a huge plus for me for long days. Love this product and would recommend it for all skin types, just use less product on oily skin.
